initial_contract: Every arm starts empty. A gets only 16 observation rows and 512 compute; B gets 192 rows and 120000 compute. Both use the ordinary public horizon 96. All programs and source concepts are learned through paid observations; no private mechanism coefficients or programs enter research. Persist complete JSON after every visit. Keep every fixed root, including A unresolved or already correct on long trajectories.
schedule_contract: Complete all first visits before continuations. Frozen 0.98 can retain its existing unresolved-task continuation but has no completed-task challenge. Version 0.99 schedules from compatible learned predictions, then acquires the proposed real distinguishing experiment and separate fresh confirmation. All screening, candidate prediction, failures and purchases consume the same shared resource pool.
baseline_interface: The old frozen session predates per-task research_limits. The runner executes its first visits explicitly with the same limits and computes its remaining pool from their sum. Its research, screening and continuation algorithms stay frozen.
knowledge_ablation_contract: After the full new arm ends, replay its actual task revisit positions and incremental allocations using only each old task's own first-visit library. Do not pass successor concepts, candidate programs, predictions, or proposed probes. candidate=None invokes ordinary continuation with the same new-resource allocation, clipped by its own remaining pool. Completed old tasks must still receive matched visits. This is a deletion-of-knowledge ablation under a given schedule, not an autonomous baseline.
evaluation_contract: After every learning and revisit phase has ended in the cohort, evaluate every latest model, including unresolved ones, on 16 fresh trajectories of 24 rows. Score its own initial model on those same actual response rows so correction of mistaken completion is separated from an initially correct model. Include the union of initial/final required channels in actual evaluation costs; also report each model's deployment channel costs separately. No terminal outcomes enter learning or scheduling.
comparisons: Report paired stream and A-task MSE, all task statuses, initial completed but long-history-inaccurate count, final correction count, screening/challenge/actual revisit counts, provided versus actually used knowledge, and complete initial/revisit/terminal resource totals. Do not drop zero-opportunity or unsuccessful roots.
scope: Eight prospectively fixed stochastic control roots of one existing continuous-state mechanism, not eight independently parameterized apparatus. Known 11811/11812 is development only. Forty-eight initial visits plus actual continuations; no post-result retuning.
